headline: Executive order addresses what it calls threats to the United States from the Russian government.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Trump on August 6, 2025, responds to actions by the Russian government that the administration says threaten the United States. The official title does not say what specific steps the order takes. Orders with similar titles often use sanctions, trade limits, or other economic measures, but no summary was provided to confirm what this one does.
